ValidationRule.description: Requires the HR tech stack detail field to be filled in for all opp lost for lacking integration
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( OR( ISCHANGED( Lost_Reason__c), ISNEW() ), OR( INCLUDES(Lost_Reason__c , "HR Tech stack/integration"), INCLUDES(Lost_Reason__c , "Missing Integration") ), ISBLANK( Lost_Reason_Details__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in the "HR Tech Stack/Integration" details.
